arguments.command: cd /app/dev && echo "=== stress & resource limits (1 GiB address space, 120s CPU) ===" && for f in stress3 stress5 stress6 stress7 stress8 stress9 big_exact big_over big_brackets; do printf "%-14s " $f; ( ulimit -v 1048576; ulimit -t 120; /usr/bin/env time -f "wall=%es rss=%MkB" /app/submission/run.sh < $f.json > /dev/null ) 2>&1 | tail -1; done
